notes.title: Clawfish: Patches and Fixes Update
notes.notes:
Clawfish has been out for two weeks now! Thank you to everyone who has played it! I've been reading the reviews and comments on Steam and itch.io about bugs and issues and have worked on a whole bunch of fixes both small and large. I'm still working out some other things that have been encountered but I'm hoping these fixes will clean up the overall experience!

[b]Below is a list of all the new things in this update. [/b]

[list]
[*] added settings (change sensitivity, smoothing, field of view and turn off fog)
[*] fixes for corner fish in claw machines
[*] remapped controls to allow some customization in the Unity input screen
[*] reduced volume for train during intro
[*] added posters on machines to clarify once a machine is cleared
[*] fixes to interactable mouse hover over areas
[*] fixed 27/28 fish bug
[*] added barrier to world for player
[*] removed "restart game" option in menu (replaced with return to title screen)
[/list]

[b]Smaller fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] increased boat speed
[*] increased walking speed for player in water
[*] added water sounds when walking in water
[*] changed walking sound effect speed
[*] fixed some funky shadows
[*] fixed some weird environment collision
[/list]

I'm planning a content update in the future so stay tuned!
